title: My Niece Forged Our Dissolution, Sold My $590K Dairy, Left Me $4,100. So I Voided The Sale
description: After 27 years as a hospital phlebotomist, I cashed out $119,000 to build an artisan goat dairy with my niece, notarizing her 45% stake and free cheese wheels for my church. She forged a dissolution, sold the operation for $590,000, and mailed me a $4,100 whey check, but I found the original agreement inside a hollow cheese press follower and voided the sale. Now she scrubs cheese molds at Curd of Deceit Creamery in coveralls that say Cultured My Trust while every label carries her fraud docket number. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #CheeseBusiness
thumb_text: SHE FORGED THE SALE, NOW SHE SCRUBS CHEESE MOLDS
pinned_comment: If your niece forged a dissolution, sold your $590,000 dairy, and mailed you a $4,100 whey check, what would you have done when you found the original notarized agreement inside that hollow cheese press? Tell me in the comments if you've ever had family try to cut you out of something you built.

thumb_lines.text: SHE MAILED ME A $4,100 WHEY CHECK AFTER STEALING MY PENSION DAIRY
